certificate_attested.hardware: 187 batches on a RunPod CPU pod (16 vCPU AMD EPYC 4564P, shared host at load 30 to 45, ten batches in parallel, nice 19), 2026-09-22 01:37 to 08:31 UTC; batches 14, 15, and 173 on an Apple silicon laptop (one core, nice 19) during the pipeline test on 2026-09-21; the aggregate's two seeded re-runs (batches 11 and 148) on the pod
certificate_attested.note: The exclusion of every rank-5 decomposition of |H>^6 lives in the 190 stored batch outputs under research/h6_rank5/results/ (15 stage A batches over the 5,939,465 full 5-covers of |H>^3 with distinct independent base states, 158 stage B batches over the 12,390 dependent covers, 17 stage C batches over the 13,852 covers with a repeated state), each matching its covers at the four base points and re-deciding every candidate mod 2013265921 and numerically. The certificate checks the partition against the enumerator, re-enumerates the degenerate covers, verifies the hashes and geometry of every output, re-decides every stored hit, and re-runs two batches from scratch; completeness rests on the stored outputs and on research/h6_rank5/batch.py, which regenerates any batch (`batch.py K`, 73.4 CPU-hours for all 190 on the pod: stage A 2.8, stage B 69.6, stage C 1.0).
